info.name: ShopVerse E2E
info.description: End-to-end API suite for ShopVerse: auth, catalog, search, cart + coupon, order saga (happy path and payment-failure compensation), payments, shipping, notifications, reviews, recommendations and presigned media uploads. Run in order (newman). See README.md.

item.name: Reusing a rotated refresh token fails

exec: pm.test('country normalised and default set', () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.country).to.eql('IN'); pm.expect(a.isDefault).to.be.true; });
pm.test('has at least two active products', () => { pm.expect(items.length).to.be.at.least(2); items.forEach(p => pm.expect(p.active).to.be.true); });
pm.test('prices are integer minor units', () => items.forEach(p => pm.expect(Number.isInteger(p.priceCents)).to.be.true));
// Avoid prices ending in .13 for the happy path (mock gateway declines those).
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().items.some(i => i.productId === pm.collectionVariables.get('productId')); } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('one line, priced from catalog', () => { pm.expect(c.items).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(c.subtotalCents).to.eql(c.items[0].unitPriceCents); });
pm.test('two lines, 3 units', () => { const c = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c.items).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(c.itemCount).to.eql(3); });
pm.test('order is PENDING with server-side pricing', () => {
pm.test('same order returned', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.orderId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId')); pm.expect(b.replayed).to.be.true; });
const done = (() => { try { return ['CONFIRMED','CANCELLED'].includes(pm.response.json().status); } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('saga state COMPLETED with payment', () => { pm.expect(o.saga.status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); pm.expect(o.paymentId).to.be.a('string'); });
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.code === 200; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('tracking number assigned', () => { const s = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(s.status).to.eql('CREATED'); pm.expect(s.trackingNumber).to.match(/^SV[0-9A-F]{12}$/); });
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().items.length === 0; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().items.some(n => n.kind === 'order_confirmed'); } catch (e) { return false; } })();
const done = (() => { try { return ['CONFIRMED','CANCELLED'].includes(pm.response.json().status); } catch (e) { return false; } })();
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().available === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('stockBefore')); } catch (e) { return false; } })();
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().items.some(i => i.productId === pm.collectionVariables.get('productId2')); } catch (e) { return false; } })();
